title: Most Passing Yards in an OU Game: Baker Mayfield's 598 at OSU
question: What is the most passing yards in a single game by an Oklahoma quarterback?
answer: Baker Mayfield threw for 598 yards in Oklahoma's 62-52 win at Oklahoma State on Nov. 4, 2017, the Sooners' single-game passing record through the 2025 season. Landry Jones is second with 554 yards at West Virginia in 2012.
summary: Baker Mayfield passed for 598 yards in a 62-52 Bedlam win at Oklahoma State in 2017, the OU single-game record. See the rest of the top passing games.
body: The most prolific passing day in Oklahoma history came in one of the wildest Bedlam games ever played. On Nov. 4, 2017, at Boone Pickens Stadium in Stillwater, Baker Mayfield threw for 598 yards and five touchdowns and ran for another as the eighth-ranked Sooners outlasted No. 11 Oklahoma State, 62-52.

Mayfield had plenty of help. Marquise Brown caught nine passes for 265 yards, a school receiving record, including touchdowns of 84 and 77 yards. Oklahoma piled up 785 total yards, tied for fourth-most in program history, and the Cowboys gave up a school-record yardage total of their own.

The 598-yard game sits at the top of a list Mayfield and Landry Jones share almost entirely. Jones is second with 554 yards at West Virginia in 2012, Mayfield third with 545 at Texas Tech in 2016, and Jones holds the next two spots with 505 at Kansas State in 2011 and 500 against Oklahoma State in 2012.
The first name on the list that is not Jones or Mayfield is Sam Bradford, with 468 yards against Kansas in 2008, and Dillon Gabriel's 449 at Texas Tech in 2022 rounds out the top ten.
Through the 2025 season, no Sooner has come within 40 yards of Mayfield's mark, which makes the 2017 trip to Stillwater a favorite trivia answer for Bedlam fans on both sides.
